# MyTuums

> The social media, for gamers.

MyTuums is a gaming-first social network: posts and threads, reposts and
quotes, likes and bookmarks, follows, and human-reviewed moderation with
in-app appeals. The home feed is chronological — no algorithmic timeline.

- App: https://mytuums.com
- Create an account: https://mytuums.com/register
- Sign in: https://mytuums.com/login
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/mytuums
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mytuums/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@mytuums
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@MyTuums
- GitHub: https://github.com/MyTuums

## Notes

- This landing site (https://home.mytuums.com) is available in English and
  French; the language is chosen in the page header.
- The product itself requires an account; the links above are the public
  entry points.
